decided_by: maintainer, 2026-10-24: new autoregressive evaluation uses nucleus sampling, never greedy decoding (logs/budget/decisions.md :: H1-PA)
_sampling: pure nucleus (top-p) sampling: top_k -1 and min_p 0 disable vLLM's other truncation filters and no penalty is applied. Temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95 are the values the teacher's model card recommends for thinking mode (Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507: Temperature=0.6, TopP=0.95, TopK=20, MinP=0, the preset run_battery's GENERATE_SAMPLING records); its TopK=20 is not used, because the protocol is pure top-p

seed_rule.namespace: the evaluated unit's key <component>__<unit> (e.g. fluid_reasoning_720__dev_v1, stage3_capability_846__gsm8k): uncapped_eval reads it from the prompt file's stem, which dose_driver.evaluate_all stages as <component>__<unit>.jsonl; run_battery takes it as --seed-namespace
seed_rule.independent_of: the model, the arm and the training seed: every checkpoint draws with the same seed for the same item, turn and sample

unchanged.context: AGENTS.md P18: each sample may generate until EOS or the trained context (8,192) minus its prompt
unchanged.stops: EOS (<|im_end|>) and the semantic degeneration stop (checked every 256 generated tokens); each sample records stop_reason eos, degeneration or context_limit
unchanged.eval_set: eval-set-1's items, validity mask and scoring protocols are not touched

records: per sample: sampling_seed, output_token_ids, stop_reason; per run: this file's path and sha256 and the sampling passed to the engine
